git_skill_scope: Full staged file blobs before the initial commit

reviewed_findings.disposition: Intentional synthetic provider-error content in a sanitization test; file unchanged from the already reviewed package.

supplemental_scope: Exact current-key byte check in every proposed file, known patterns in text; retained PNGs were visually reviewed and WOFF2 font files have accompanying OFL notices.
limitations: The Git-specific scanner omits binaries and does not scan history or unknown credential formats. No claim of a universal clean scan.
